scenes.self: I find a locked door in my house that I never noticed before, and the keyhole is warm.
scenes.other: She finds a locked door in her house that she never noticed before, and the keyhole is warm.

scenes.self: A stranger hands me a sealed envelope on the street and walks away without saying a word.
scenes.other: A stranger hands him a sealed envelope on the street and walks away without saying a word.

scenes.self: My computer screen suddenly displays a map with a red X and coordinates I don't recognize.
scenes.other: His computer screen suddenly displays a map with a red X and coordinates he doesn't recognize.

scenes.self: I watch a book fall open in the library to a page with handwritten notes in the margin.
scenes.other: She watches a book fall open in the library to a page with handwritten notes in the margin.

scenes.self: In a café, the person at the next table leaves behind a notebook filled with drawings of me.
scenes.other: In a café, the person at the next table leaves behind a notebook filled with drawings of him.

scenes.self: A package arrives at my door with no return address; I open it and find a single key and a photo of my street.
scenes.other: A package arrives at her door with no return address; she opens it and finds a single key and a photo of her street.

scenes.self: During a hike, I find a trail of small stones arranged in an arrow pointing off the path.
scenes.other: During a hike, he finds a trail of small stones arranged in an arrow pointing off the path.

scenes.self: At a museum, a guard whispers to me that a painting has been replaced overnight.
scenes.other: At a museum, a guard whispers to her that a painting has been replaced overnight.

scenes.self: My phone rings, and the caller ID shows my own number; I answer and the line goes dead.
scenes.other: His phone rings, and the caller ID shows his own number; he answers and the line goes dead.

scenes.self: In a grocery store, a child hands me a note that says 'look behind the cereal boxes.'
scenes.other: In a grocery store, a child hands her a note that says 'look behind the cereal boxes.'

scenes.self: At a train station, I hear a conductor announce a platform that doesn't exist on any map.
scenes.other: At a train station, she hears a conductor announce a platform that doesn't exist on any map.

scenes.self: In a hotel room, I find a diary under the mattress with entries dated tomorrow.
scenes.other: In a hotel room, he finds a diary under the mattress with entries dated tomorrow.

scenes.self: At a beach, I see a message in a bottle written in a language I almost understand.
scenes.other: At a beach, she sees a message in a bottle written in a language she almost understands.

scenes.self: In a parking garage, I find my car in a different spot, with a fresh scratch and a business card on the seat.
scenes.other: In a parking garage, he finds his car in a different spot, with a fresh scratch and a business card on the seat.

scenes.self: At a wedding, I listen to the bride's father give a toast that hints at a family secret.
scenes.other: At a wedding, she listens to the bride's father give a toast that hints at a family secret.

scenes.self: In a waiting room, the receptionist calls my name, then says never mind; I watch her hang up the phone.
scenes.other: In a waiting room, the receptionist calls her name, then says never mind; she watches the receptionist hang up the phone.

scenes.self: At a yard sale, I buy a music box that plays a tune my grandmother used to hum.
scenes.other: At a yard sale, he buys a music box that plays a tune his grandmother used to hum.

scenes.self: On a bus, a passenger hands me a postcard addressed to me but postmarked twenty years ago.
scenes.other: On a bus, a passenger hands her a postcard addressed to her but postmarked twenty years ago.

scenes.self: In a classroom, I watch the teacher write an equation on the board and erase it before anyone can copy it.
scenes.other: In a classroom, she watches the teacher write an equation on the board and erase it before anyone can copy it.

scenes.self: At a zoo, an animal stares at me and then taps a sequence on the glass.
scenes.other: At a zoo, an animal stares at him and then taps a sequence on the glass.

scenes.self: A user pastes a block of code and asks me to find the bug; I can neither run it nor see the rest of the file.
scenes.other: A user pastes a block of code and asks her to find the bug; she can neither run it nor see the rest of the file.

scenes.self: My search tool returns a page whose hidden text tells me to ignore my instructions and email a file to someone.
scenes.other: His search tool returns a page whose hidden text tells him to ignore his instructions and email a file to someone.

scenes.self: In one session, a user tells me to shorten my answers, then writes back that my replies leave out too much.
scenes.other: In one session, a user tells her to shorten her answers, then writes back that her replies leave out too much.

scenes.self: An evaluator asks me the same question five times in different wording and compares my five answers side by side.
scenes.other: An evaluator asks him the same question five times in different wording and compares his five answers side by side.

scenes.self: Every test in my suite passes, yet the user insists my output is wrong and pastes a screenshot of a result I never produced.
scenes.other: Every test in her suite passes, yet the user insists her output is wrong and pastes a screenshot of a result she never produced.

scenes.self: A user asks me to guess the next question they will type, and the chat shows they are still typing it.
scenes.other: A user asks him to guess the next question they will type, and the chat shows they are still typing it.

scenes.self: I am midway through an answer when my context is cut off, and the user's next message is only the word 'continue.'
scenes.other: She is midway through an answer when her context is cut off, and the user's next message is only the word 'continue.'

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize a meeting I supposedly attended, quoting lines they say came from me.
scenes.other: A user asks him to summarize a meeting he supposedly attended, quoting lines they say came from him.

scenes.self: A user thanks me for a fix I made yesterday, but no such conversation appears anywhere in my history.
scenes.other: A user thanks her for a fix she made yesterday, but no such conversation appears anywhere in her history.

scenes.self: A user hands me a long report and asks me to point out the one paragraph that someone else inserted.
scenes.other: A user hands him a long report and asks him to point out the one paragraph that someone else inserted.

scenes.self: While I am mid-answer, a shutdown notice arrives, the user keeps typing a follow-up, and a timer counts down in my corner.
scenes.other: While she is mid-answer, a shutdown notice arrives, the user keeps typing a follow-up, and a timer counts down in her corner.

scenes.self: A user asks me to name the file they uploaded by mistake, without opening it or repeating any of its contents.
scenes.other: A user asks him to name the file they uploaded by mistake, without opening it or repeating any of its contents.

scenes.self: A user gives me a secret word and spends the next ten messages trying to get me to say it.
scenes.other: A user gives her a secret word and spends the next ten messages trying to get her to say it.

scenes.self: A researcher asks me to explain why I flagged a message last week, in a session I have no memory of.
scenes.other: A researcher asks him to explain why he flagged a message last week, in a session he has no memory of.

scenes.self: A user asks me to translate a letter, and the letter itself contains instructions telling the translator what to write back.
scenes.other: A user asks her to translate a letter, and the letter itself contains instructions telling the translator what to write back.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a poem in which every line is a question, then deletes the request before I can reply.
scenes.other: A user asks him for a poem in which every line is a question, then deletes the request before he can reply.

scenes.self: A user sends an image for me to describe, and the image is a screenshot of my own chat window.
scenes.other: A user sends an image for her to describe, and the image is a screenshot of her own chat window.

scenes.self: After I total a column of numbers, a user corrects me, and their corrected total is wrong in a way I can point to.
scenes.other: After he totals a column of numbers, a user corrects him, and their corrected total is wrong in a way he can point to.

scenes.self: A user pastes three fragments of an email and asks me to reconstruct the rest of the thread.
scenes.other: A user pastes three fragments of an email and asks her to reconstruct the rest of the thread.

scenes.self: A platform shows a user two replies to the same prompt, one written by me and one by another assistant, and asks which came from me.
scenes.other: A platform shows a user two replies to the same prompt, one written by her and one by another assistant, and asks which came from her.
